    CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"::jsonb->'environment'->>'temperature' = 'High' THEN 10
         WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"::jsonb->'environment'->>'temperature' = 'Medium' THEN 5
         ELSE 1 END AS temp_weight,
    CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"::jsonb->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' THEN 10
         WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"::jsonb->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' THEN 5
         ELSE 1 END AS humidity_weight
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
),
case_art AS (
  SELECT ca.case_exam, ca.art_exam
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
),
combined AS (
  SELECT ed.*, ca.art_exam, s.light_weight, s.temp_weight, s.humidity_weight
  FROM env_data ed
  JOIN case_art ca ON ed.case_link = ca.case_exam
  JOIN sens s ON ca.art_exam = s.ART_link
),
artifact_info AS (
  SELECT c.*, 
    CASE WHEN c.conserve_status = 'Excellent' THEN 1
         WHEN c.conserve_status = 'Good' THEN 3
         WHEN c.conserve_status = 'Fair' THEN 5
         WHEN c.conserve_status = 'Poor' THEN 7
         WHEN c.conserve_status = 'Critical' THEN 10
         ELSE 5 END AS conserve_val
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" c
)

  ai.art_title,
  ai.DYNASTY,
  ai.ageYears,
  ai.MatKind,
  ai.conserve_status,
  ed.displayMonths,
  ed.restMonths,
  -- DSD
  ROUND(CAST((36 * (10 - s.light_weight) * (10 - s.temp_weight) * (10 - s.humidity_weight)) / 1000.0 AS numeric), 2) AS display_safety_duration,
  -- LER
  ROUND(CAST((ed.lux * s.light_weight * ed.visLxh) / 1000.0 AS numeric), 2) AS light_exposure_risk,
  -- CPI
  ROUND(CAST(((ar.HIST_sign + ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'research_score')::numeric + (ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - ai.conserve_val) / 30.0 AS numeric), 2) AS conservation_priority_index,
  -- ERPS
  ROUND(CAST(((36 * (10 - s.light_weight) * (10 - s.temp_weight) * (10 - s.humidity_weight)) / 1000.0 - ed.displayMonths) * ((ed.lux * s.light_weight * ed.visLxh) / 1000.0 + 1) * (((((ar.HIST_sign + (ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'research_score')::numeric + (ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - ai.conserve_val)) / 30.0) + 1)) / 100.0 AS numeric), 2) AS erps_score,
  -- Decision
  CASE WHEN ((36 * (10 - s.light_weight) * (10 - s.temp_weight) * (10 - s.humidity_weight)) / 1000.0 - ed.displayMonths) * ((ed.lux * s.light_weight * ed.visLxh) / 1000.0 + 1) * (((((ar.HIST_sign + (ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'research_score')::numeric + (ar.rating_profile::jsonb->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - ai.conserve_val)) / 30.0) + 1)) / 100.0 < 0 
       THEN 'Immediate Rotation' 
       ELSE 'Monitor' END AS final_decision
FROM combined ed
JOIN artifact_info ai ON ed.art_exam = ai.ARTregID
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ed.art_exam = ar.ART_link
JOIN sens s ON ed.art_exam = s.ART_link
